# PCA / ICA baseline results

Result logs for the PCA / ICA / raw-layer baselines added in the
"linear-decomposition baselines" PR. Generated by the runners in `jobs/local/`
and `analysis/sweep_pca_ica_dim.py`. See `EXPERIMENTS.md` §5b-§5d for methodology.

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `summary.md` | **Start here** — all headline tables (MS, NFP, sweep, diagonal-dominance) in one place |
| `ms_scores.md` | MS score comparison table (SAE / raw / PCA / ICA) |
| `ms_pca_sign_split.txt` | PCA MS: mean +/- std + top/bottom-10 features (eval/metric.py output) |
| `ms_ica_sign_split.txt` | ICA MS: mean +/- std + top/bottom-10 features |
| `nfp_selectivity.md` | NFP significant-feature counts + selectivity (diagonal) matrices, raw/PCA/ICA |
| `sweep_dim_sign_split.csv` | MS + NFP vs #components D, sign_split mode |
| `sweep_dim_signed.csv` | MS + NFP vs #components D, signed mode (robustness) |

Numbers are from a local single-GPU run (256 components / ~600k-token fit); the SAE
column is the cluster reference. They are the valid *relative* comparison.
